text:
Maya (AM): kicking off reseller pilot with StratusOne — need a concise technical handoff. Main asks: SSO + SCIM, entitlement mapping, network allowlist, pricing model for reseller, and a runbook for tenant provisioning + onboarding tests. cc @Alex (Solutions) @Samir (SRE)

Alex (Solutions): on it. do we already have a tenant template + IAM/role mapping we can reuse?

Samir (SRE): we need partner egress IPs and expected TLS setup. partner wants to call our private endpoint from their VPC; will require allowlist + client certs.

Jia (Security): security checklist: completed security questionnaire, SOC2 link, KMS usage, and ATO items. also clarify data residency and encryption-at-rest requirements.

Todd (Partnerships): pricing note — partner expects a reseller rate for first 6 months (they resell to 3 customers). sales will need a SKU for a "reseller-dedicated" offering. tagging billing for follow-up. :memo:

Maya (AM): proposed runbook skeleton: 1) entitlement mapping (SCIM groups -> product tiers) 2) SSO/SAML setup + SCIM provisioning tests 3) network allowlist & cert exchange 4) billing/entitlement onboarding 5) smoke tests and rollback playbook. can someone pick pieces?

Alex (Solutions): i'll draft the SAML/SCIM steps (metadata, ACS, entityID, group mappings) and include a minimal test plan. pinging Samir for the networking snippet to include. :+1:

Samir (SRE): networking snippet to share with partner:

```
# partner-firewall example (partner side)
# allow outbound to staging and prod endpoints
-A OUTPUT -d 3.21.45.67/32 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -d 3.21.45.68/32 -j ACCEPT
# prod endpoint
prod.redwood-inference.net:443
# staging endpoint
staging.redwood-inference.net:443
```

Also: client cert exchange is manual for now — partner uploads CSR to partner portal, we return signed cert. add note about TLS cert rotation and expiration checks.

Jia (Security): add these security requirements to runbook:
- mTLS enforced for control-plane calls
- KMS key ARN required for customer-managed keys
- no logging of PII in app logs (redaction policy)
- share SOC2 report and contact for compliance review

Maya (AM): partner prefers to validate SSO first then wired billing. can we do SAML + SCIM for group sync?

Alex (Solutions): yes — SCIM provisioning available. minimal permissions: scim:write:users, scim:read:groups. provide sample curl provisioning call in doc.

Samir (SRE): for provisioning tests use a staging token with limited quota and a sandbox account. endpoint: https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/accounts/provision -> returns account_id. example: 
```
POST /v1/accounts/provision
Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN_xxx
{ "partner_org": "stratusone", "admin_email": "alice@stratus.one" }
```

Todd (Partnerships): pricing proposal draft: 10% reseller discount on hosted API usage for first 6 months + $2,000/month reserved commitment for up to X RU. i'll formalize numbers and attach to the runbook.

Maya (AM): next steps and owners: Alex -> SAML/SCIM doc by EOD; Samir -> allowlist IPs and cert exchange steps by tomorrow morning; Jia -> answer security questionnaire and attach SOC2 link; Todd -> pricing draft. partner meeting scheduled Wed 10am PT. @deploy-bot please set reminder 1h before. :calendar:

deploy-bot: reminder set for 2023-10-04T09:00:00Z (1 hour before meeting)

Samir (SRE): IP ranges for partner allowlist: 3.21.45.67, 3.21.45.68, 3.21.45.69. staging endpoint is staging.redwood-inference.net:443. added note about keepalive and idle timeouts.

Jia (Security): SOC2 report link (internal): https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2.pdf — will attach redacted questionnaire answers to runbook.

Alex (Solutions): uploaded SAML/SCIM draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/presales/runbooks/pull/42 — includes metadata XML example and SCIM sample payloads.

Maya (AM): perfect — thanks all. i'll consolidate into a single handoff doc and share with StratusOne before Wed. please add any call notes to the PR. :raised_hands:

Samir (SRE): one more ops note — include a smoke test script snippet we can run post-provision:
```
# smoke test
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN" https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/models/list
# expect 200 and models array
```

Alex (Solutions): will add that test to the SAML doc.

Maya (AM): closing loop — i'll send calendar invite and include runbook link once consolidated. thanks everyone.
